species.name: Trout
why: Water 53°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 36–40 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 70 ft, cold below.

species.name: Lake trout
why: Water 53°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 32–120 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 70 ft, cold below.
Clear water: they bite best at dawn, dusk and on cloudy days.
